title: The Last World Museum
premise: A museum outside normal time preserves history, myth, and hidden wounds until the exhibits begin bleeding together.
theme: History is not just what happened. It is what people choose to remember.

protagonist.title: The Uncatalogued
protagonist.origin: A stolen child raised by the museum with no official exhibit tag.
protagonist.arc: I am not an error just because I do not fit your records.

chapter.name: The Plague Wing
chapter.fact: A quarantined town faces disease, fear, and failing institutions.
chapter.myth: The town believes plague is divine punishment.
chapter.wound: The museum edits medical truth and human guilt into a clean religious exhibit.

empty_rotunda.beat: The protagonist wakes during an emergency alarm. Exhibit doors are sealed and docents are missing.

broken_exhibit_door.beat: A plague-fogged door breaks open and the Curator orders the player to seal the Plague Wing.

plague_town_street.beat: The town is trapped in the same quarantine day while townspeople blame sickness on spiritual corruption.

apothecary_house.beat: The Plague Apothecary remembers dying yesterday and joins because the loop is starting to crack.

chapel.beat: The church warden insists the infected are spiritually corrupt while the chapel hides impossible architecture.

underchapel_drain.beat: A sewer beneath Hallowmere mixes chapel runoff, hospital waste, and impossible museum infrastructure.

hidden_hospital_corridor.beat: A hospital corridor behind the chapel proves the museum has been editing the town's history.

bell_tower_boss_room.mood: prayer, guilt, and disease made physical
bell_tower_boss_room.beat: The church warden rings the plague bell and the archive manifests The Bell Saint.

boss.name: The Bell Saint
boss.description: A saint-like monster made from prayer, guilt, disease, and the quarantine bell.
